pareto_dominance.definition: Pareto dominance over lower zstd median bytes and higher relative-preservation count, absolute-service count, localization count, and segmentation-installability; at least one objective must be strict.
pareto_dominance.policy: diagnostic only; no dominated profile is removed or disabled
